Workflow Overview

This workflow automates the complete event reservation process using n8n.

Main features:
• Receives event reservations through an online form
• Validates participant information
• Automatically assigns the next available time slot when the requested slot is full
• Stores reservation data in Data Tables
• Updates slot capacity in real time
• Generates a unique ticket ID
• Creates a QR code for each reservation
• Sends an e-ticket via Gmail
• Notifies organizers through Discord
• Keeps a live Discord availability board updated

The workflow is designed to minimize manual work while providing participants with an automated reservation experience.




Who is this workflow for?

This workflow is designed for Japanese organizations and communities that manage scheduled events with limited capacity.

Typical use cases include:
• Universities
• Workshops
• Conferences
• Community events
• Open campus events
• Club activities

Participants complete a Japanese reservation form, automatically receive an assigned time slot, a QR-based e-ticket by email, and organizers receive Discord notifications.

The workflow reduces manual work, prevents overbooking, and provides a smooth reservation experience for both participants and organizers.

Reservation Form


Receives reservation requests from participants.

Normalize Input


Formats and validates the submitted form data.

Find Available Slot

Checks availability and automatically assigns the next available slot if necessary.

Generate Ticket

Creates a unique ticket ID for the reservation.

Slot Available?


Determines whether a reservation can be accepted.

Create Reservation

Stores participant information in the reservation database.

Update Slot Capacity

Updates the remaining capacity for the assigned time slot.

Generate QR Code

Creates a QR code containing the ticket ID.

Send E-Ticket

Sends the participant an email containing their QR ticket.

Send Reservation Notification

Notifies administrators in Discord.

Reload Time Slots

Retrieves the latest slot information.

Build Availability Message

Builds a live availability summary.

Get Message Settings

Retrieves the stored Discord message ID.

time_slots_v2

Retrieves the current time slot information from the Data Table, including capacity, reservation count, and availability status.

Save Message ID

Stores the Discord message ID in the Data Table so the same message can be updated instead of creating duplicate messages.

Update Discord Message / Send a Message

Updates the existing Discord message or creates a new one.

Send Full Capacity Notification

Notifies administrators through Discord when all available time slots are fully booked and no further reservations can be accepted.

Message Exists?

Checks whether the availability message already exists.

Update row(s)

Updates the reservation record by saving the generated ticket ID and other reservation details in the Data Table.

Send Full Capacity Notification

Notifies administrators when no reservation can be accepted.

Update Discord Message / Send a Message

Updates the existing Discord message or creates a new one.
